name: Dried buffalo meat
summary: Dân Việt describes smoked buffalo of the Thái đen, served to guests. Vietnam Tourism names dried buffalo meat and does not describe it. The loop page says buffalo meat in the same try-list and does not say dried. All three stay.
origin: Đồng Văn on Dân Việt. The plateau on the other two pages.
taste: Dân Việt: numbing and hot from mắc khén, sweet from the meat, with kitchen smoke.
howToEat: Eat it as a meat, or buy it to carry. No price is given. The price is Check on arrival.
where: Đồng Văn market, or a household, on Dân Việt. No clock is given.
seoTitle: Dried buffalo meat in Dong Van — thit trau gac bep
seoDescription: Thịt trâu gác bếp is smoked buffalo on Dân Việt. Vietnam Tourism names dried buffalo meat. The loop page says buffalo meat. All three stay.
